title: At Last, One Big Layoff Not Caused By AI
excerpt: AI keeps getting the blame for mass layoffs across corporate America, but one major company just made a surprising cut for a completely different reason, and...
content_html:
Douglas A. McIntyre

Thu, August 6, 2026 at 9:54 AM MST 2 min read

Quick Read

  • Etsy (ETSY) laid off 12% of its workforce for strategic refocusing rather than for AI reasons, while posting 6% revenue growth to $668 million.

  • Block (XYZ) axed 40% of its workforce and Oracle (ORCL) fired 21,000 workers, both citing AI-driven productivity gains as justification.

  • Act now: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just named his top 10 AI stocks — and Etsy didn't make the cut. Grab the names FREE today.

AI is already behind tens of thousands of layoffs, according to the companies that made them. The most well-known is that Block (NYSE: XYZ) laid off 40% of its workforce in March. Oracle (NASDAQ: ORCL) fired 21,000 people earlier this year.

The layoffs were made in the name of AI, making their workforces more productive. However, skeptics said it was simply a matter of improving the bottom line. This was cynical and impossible to prove.

The Oracle and Block layoffs were part of what is supposed to be an AI Armageddon. This would spread from junior bankers who analyze bank deals to the people who handle checkout at Walmart (NYSE: WMT). The figure is supposed to eventually be in the millions. If so, it could drive US unemployment to double digits and damage the economy.

Finally, a company has said it will lay people off to return to its core business. Etsy (NASDAQ: ETSY) cut 12% of its workforce, which was 220 people. Most were in its product and engineering operations. It forcefully said AI was not a factor. It was just a simple way to make its business more focused. The cuts weren't driven by cost-cutting initiatives or artificial intelligence, Chief Executive Kruti Goyal said in a message to Etsy's workers. "Buyers are discovering products in new ways. Sellers have access to increasingly powerful tools to build their businesses. And the expectations they have of Etsy continue to rise."

Act now: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just named his top 10 AI stocks — and Etsy didn't make the cut. Grab the names FREE today.

Etsy posted strong quarterly earnings when it made the worker announcement. Revenue rose 6% to $668 million from the same period the year before. EPS rose to $.98 from $.39. The numbers were from "continuing operations." It had sold one of its divisions, which affected its figures.

Etsy's announcement does not prove that AI will never affect job decisions. It does show, however, that sometimes a layoff is just a layoff because a company can make more sense of itself when it restructures.

  • Block (XYZ) 裁员 40%，Oracle (ORCL) 解雇 21,000 名员工，两者都以人工智能驱动的生产力提高为理由。
  • 立即行动：2010 年给 NVIDIA 打电话的分析师刚刚列出了他心目中的十大人工智能股票，而 Etsy 却没有上榜。 今天免费获取名字。

据裁员公司称，人工智能已经导致了数万人裁员。 最著名的是 Block (NYSE: XYZ) 在 3 月份解雇了 40% 的员工。 甲骨文（纳斯达克股票代码：ORCL）今年早些时候解雇了 21,000 名员工。

此次裁员是以人工智能的名义进行的，旨在提高员工的生产力。 然而，怀疑论者表示，这只是一个提高利润的问题。 这是愤世嫉俗的，而且无法证明。

Oracle 和 Block 的裁员是人工智能世界末日的一部分。 这将从分析银行交易的初级银行家蔓延到在沃尔玛（纽约证券交易所股票代码：WMT）处理结账的人员。 这个数字最终预计将达到数百万。 如果真是这样，美国的失业率可能会上升至两位数，并损害经济。

最后，一家公司表示将裁员以重返核心业务。 Etsy（纳斯达克股票代码：ETSY）裁员 12%，共计 220 人。 其中大部分是在其产品和工程运营中。 它有力地表示人工智能不是一个因素。 这只是一种使其业务更加集中的简单方法。 Etsy 首席执行官克鲁蒂·戈亚尔 (Kruti Goyal) 在给员工的信息中表示，此次裁员并非由成本削减举措或人工智能推动。 “买家正在以新的方式发现产品。 卖家可以使用日益强大的工具来建立自己的业务。 他们对 Etsy 的期望持续上升。”

立即行动：2010 年给 NVIDIA 打电话的分析师刚刚列出了他心目中的十大人工智能股票，而 Etsy 却没有上榜。 今天免费获取名字。

Etsy 在发布员工公告时发布了强劲的季度收益。 收入较上年同期增长 6%，达到 6.68 亿美元。 每股收益从 0.39 美元升至 0.98 美元。 这些数字来自“持续经营”。 该公司出售了其一个部门，这影响了其业绩。

Etsy 的声明并不能证明人工智能永远不会影响工作决策。 然而，它确实表明，有时裁员只是裁员，因为公司在重组时可以使自己更有意义。
